description: This file provides support for wchar_t and exotic character types in the formatting library, including type traits, string views, format functions, and utilities for wide character formatting.

classes.name: basic_fstring
classes.description: A template class for formatting strings with wchar_t, supporting static and runtime format strings.

methods.name: write_loc
methods.description: Writes locale-specific information to an appender for wchar_t.

methods.name: make_wformat_args
methods.description: Creates format arguments for wchar_t types.

methods.name: operator""_a
methods.description: User-defined literal for wchar_t format arguments.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins ranges or initializer lists with a wchar_t separator.

methods.name: vformat
methods.description: Formats a string with wchar_t support, returning a std::wstring.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a string with wchar_t support, returning a std::wstring.

methods.name: format_to
methods.description: Formats a string into an output iterator with wchar_t support.

methods.name: format_to_n
methods.description: Formats a string into an output iterator with wchar_t support, limited by size.

methods.name: formatted_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of the formatted string with wchar_t support.

methods.name: vprint
methods.description: Prints formatted wchar_t string to FILE or wostream.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints formatted wchar_t string to FILE or wostream.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Prints formatted wchar_t string with newline to FILE or wostream.

methods.name: to_wstring
methods.description: Converts a value to std::wstring using default format.
